item.subject: science
item.stem:
In a scrapyard near Pune, Sameer uses a lifting electromagnet attached to a crane to move iron sheets.

When the current in the electromagnet is switched ON, what happens to the iron sheet, and what happens to it when the current is switched OFF?

options.A: ON: the iron sheet is released. OFF: the iron sheet is lifted.
options.B: ON: the iron sheet is lifted. OFF: the iron sheet is released.
options.C: ON: the iron sheet is lifted. OFF: the iron sheet keeps being held.
options.D: ON: the iron sheet is released. OFF: the iron sheet stays released.
